admissionDecision: These 11 works are admitted as the first remote-first canonical Chinese collection set because their title/year identities are exposed by the source and the source explicitly marks works through 1930 public domain and downloadable. Exact per-item delivery endpoints are a delivery-resolution concern, not a Work-identity prerequisite.
next: Expand the pre-1931 CLSC non-Bible set beyond the initial 11, resolve exact per-item endpoints opportunistically, and merge legacy Yale Chinese identities without duplicating canonical Works.
